subject: general
question: By the Act of ________, the Governor General in Council was given the power to legislate for the whole of the British territories in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charter Act of 1833**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Charter Act of 1833** marked a significant shift in British governance in India.
 
• It centralized the administration by granting the Governor General in Council the power to legislate for the entire British territories in India.</l
